changes.comment: BREAKING: The public Feishu formatter now returns structured Channel-owned content/ref XML, renders downloaded inline attachments as path-only elements and non-downloaded attachments as status/key-only elements, and renders create time as process-local unpadded time instead of UTC ISO. Accepted unnamed human turns may await a best-effort contact lookup for up to two seconds. Consumers that parse formatter body text, attachment attributes, or ISO timestamps must adopt the new contracts.
